companies.name: Taganito Mining Corporation (TMC)
companies.location: Barangays Taganito & Hayanggabon, Claver, Surigao del Norte
companies.description: Taganito Mining Corporation (TMC) is one of the largest nickel mining operations in the Philippines. Operating in Claver since 1987, TMC extracts high-grade and medium-grade nickel laterite ore supplied to domestic hydrometallurgical processing (THPAL) and international markets.
companies.source_agency: DENR Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB) & NAC Annual Disclosures

companies.name: Taganito HPAL Nickel Corporation (THPAL)
companies.parent_company: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd. & Nickel Asia Corp
companies.location: Taganito Special Economic Zone, Barangay Taganito, Claver
companies.tenement_type: PEZA Export Processing Zone / Mineral Processing License
companies.description: THPAL operates the Philippines' state-of-the-art High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) hydrometallurgical processing plant in Claver. It processes low-grade nickel limonite ore into high-value Mixed Nickel-Cobalt Sulfide used globally in EV battery production and technology manufacturing.

companies.name: Platinum Group Metals Corporation (PGMC)
companies.location: Barangay Cagdianao, Claver, Surigao del Norte
companies.description: PGMC operates the Cagdianao Nickel Expansion Project in Claver. It is a major exporter of high-grade saprolite and limonite nickel ore to international smelting facilities and maintains extensive SDMP and environmental protection programs across coastal barangays.
companies.source_agency: DENR-MGB Caraga Region XIII & FNI SEC Filings

companies.name: Shenzhou Mining & Development Corporation (SMDC / CMDC)
companies.description: SMDC holds mineral production sharing agreements in northern Claver, supplying raw nickel ore for industrial processing while contributing to local community development funds under DENR regulatory oversight.

companies.name: CTP Construction and Mining Corporation
companies.description: CTP Mining operates the Adlay Nickel Project in coastal Claver, implementing mandatory Social Development Management Programs (SDMP) and Environmental Protection and Enhancement Programs (EPEP).

sdmp_projects.title: Barangay Taganito Multi-Purpose Tribal & Cultural Center
sdmp_projects.description: Construction of a modern 2-storey tribal hall and community center equipped with emergency evacuation facilities and IP council meeting chambers.
sdmp_projects.source_doc: TMC Annual SDMP Performance Report 2024 (DENR-MGB XIII Submitted)

sdmp_projects.title: College & Technical Vocational Scholarship Program
sdmp_projects.description: Full tertiary tuition, monthly living allowance, book stipend, and board review assistance for 420 local students pursuing Engineering, Nursing, Agriculture, and Education.
sdmp_projects.source_doc: PGMC SDMP Educational Accomplishment Report Q4 2024

sdmp_projects.title: Claver Coastal Barangay Water Distribution Pipeline Network
sdmp_projects.description: Installation of 12-kilometer potable water transmission pipelines, filtration tanks, and household tap connections benefiting 2,800 coastal households.
sdmp_projects.source_doc: THPAL Community Infrastructure SDMP Turnover Record 2024

sdmp_projects.title: Fisherfolk Livelihood & Motorized Banka Distribution
sdmp_projects.description: Provision of 85 fiberglass motorized fishing boats, deep-sea fishing nets, safety equipment, and cold storage units to accredited municipal fisherfolk associations.

sdmp_projects.title: Barangay Cagdianao Rural Health Station & Ambulance Procurement
sdmp_projects.description: Construction of a fully equipped primary health station and turnover of a Type II basic life support ambulance to Barangay Cagdianao.
sdmp_projects.source_doc: PGMC Health & Medical Assistance SDMP Summary

community_investments.name: Claver National High School Science & Computer Laboratory Building
community_investments.description: Two-storey 8-classroom building equipped with 50 high-speed computers, biology/chemistry lab equipment, and solar power backup.
community_investments.source: LGU Claver Municipal Engineering & SDMP Verification File

community_investments.name: Hayanggabon Evacuation Center & Multi-Purpose Gym
community_investments.description: Typhoon-resilient multi-purpose facility capable of sheltering 1,200 evacuees during severe weather events, featuring standby generators and sanitation blocks.
community_investments.source: MDRRMO Claver & TMC Infrastructure Turnover Report

community_investments.description: Concrete paving of 6.2 kilometers of agricultural road connecting interior upland farms to the national highway network.
